body.name: observed-data randomized interval experiment
body.construction: An admissible procedure is one Markov kernel \(K(dI\mid O)\), fixed independently of the schedule, from \(O\) to nonempty closed subintervals of \([-2M,2M]\). Realize it as \(I_K=F_K(O,U_{\mathrm{aux}})\) with \(U_{\mathrm{aux}}\sim\operatorname{Unif}(0,1)\) independent of the randomization experiment. Under the resulting extended law, \(\mathcal C_\alpha=\{K:\inf_{Y\in\mathcal Y_{M,\Gamma}}P^K_{\mathcal D,Y}(\tau_W\in I_K)\ge1-\alpha\}\) and \(\mathfrak L_\alpha^\star=\inf_{K\in\mathcal C_\alpha}\sup_{Y\in\mathcal Y_{M,\Gamma}}\mathbb E^K_{\mathcal D,Y}[\operatorname{len}(I_K)]\).
